arguments.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
key_claims: Released frozen patch features and distilled small models provide a practical baseline for adding visual structure without foundation-model training. Image/global and patch objectives do not guarantee exact chromatic information. Start with ViT-S/14 plus explicit color/layout channels, retain a dimension-matched random-capacity control, and evaluate independent event targets rather than reconstructing supplied statistics. Public pretraining can overlap source imagery; canonical grouping does not prove absence of pretraining exposure.
